content.text:
The business data is mostly still available. What we cannot reproduce honestly is the old simulated “agent experience” because those details were fixtures, not live backend data.

### Already available

The backend’s [CaseSnapshot](/Users/lorenzkrinner/conductor/workspaces/ehl_hack/seville/packages/contracts/models.py:446) already contains:

- Candidates and policy results
- Supplier records
- Outreach tasks
- Claims, prices, quantities and lead times
- Claim evidence and completed transcripts
- Call/recording URLs when provided
- Strategies and landed-cost breakdowns
- Recommended decision, reports and PR
- Case events and checklist timestamps

But the frontend [CaseSnapshot type](/Users/lorenzkrinner/conductor/workspaces/ehl_hack/seville/apps/web/lib/live/types.ts:84) currently declares only candidates and supplier records. We should expand it to match the backend contract.

The sidebar can also use the existing `GET /cases` endpoint instead of remaining completely fake.

### What we cannot currently display

| Previously shown | Current limitation |
|---|---|
| Named agents such as “Mara” or “Oskar” | No agent identity is returned |
| Queued → dialing → connected → completed | Backend currently exposes mostly pending/active/done |
| Progressively appearing call transcript | Transcript becomes available after the Claim is collected |
| Precise live call duration | Can be derived from plan timestamps, but provider timing is limited |
| Devin’s actual tool calls and outputs | Case events contain summaries, not Devin’s internal tool stream |
| Streaming assistant messages | No Devin message-stream endpoint |
| User follow-up messages | No send-message endpoint yet |
| “Buyer recorded this decision” | Backend has an automated recommendation, but no human-selection record/interface |

The calling trigger can therefore truthfully show:

> Calling agent · Kugellager Bayern · 0:32

But it should not invent an agent name, connected state, or transcript turn that the backend never supplied.

### Data-model shape

I’d introduce a pure `buildCockpitView(snapshot, plan, events)` module that produces only renderable information:

```ts
type ComposerState =
  | { status: "disabled"; reason: string }
  | { status: "ready" | "submitting" | "streaming" | "error" }

type CallActivity = {
  taskId: string
  supplierRef: string
  supplierName: string
  status: "queued" | "active" | "completed" | "failed"
  startedAt?: string
  completedAt?: string
  claim?: Claim
}

type CockpitView = {
  sections: ActivitySection[]
  calls: CallActivity[]
  composer: ComposerState
}
```

The composer would be fully mounted, controlled and responsive, but receive:

```ts
{ status: "disabled", reason: "Follow-up messaging is not connected yet." }
```

Later, enabling messaging changes the state and adds the transport adapter without restructuring the UI.

The historical checkpoint has no generated summary, so this availability comparison is based directly on the old UI fixtures and current backend contracts.

+Reason: Conductor workspaces do not inherit uncommitted changes from another worktree, and a branch can only be checked out in one worktree at a time.

+## Repository context
+
+Follow the repository `AGENTS.md` and read these before editing:

+- `README.md`

+- Rehearsal remains the default.

+- Preserve exact Decimal money values; frontend transport values should remain strings.
+- Mask phone numbers outside the outbound-call boundary.

+## Historical reference
+
+- `64a2bb67948ac5c99a83a512df43290a6ea5141e` introduced the early UI/API cockpit; it is not the commit that removed the requested UI.
+- `c280086310c2aba9416e10edb58e24d5123a6798` contains the prior sidebar, composer, collapsibles, calling-agent presentation, deterministic calls, and call-detail UI. Use it as a visual and interaction reference only.
+- `67b60bf7bbbe081a13abe1256be9ae78945bd74f` removed `message-composer.tsx` and `session-sidebar.tsx`, and replaced the deterministic transcript/call presentation with live case/checklist data.

+## User requirements
+
+### Left sidebar
+
+- Restore the left session sidebar using the existing sidebar primitives.
+- Preserve the existing right-side candidate inspector.
+- The sidebar may initially be sparse/stub-like, but should fit the live case model.
+- The backend already exposes `GET /cases`, so real case summaries can be used without backend work if this remains a focused frontend change.

+### Disabled composer
+
+- Restore the composer at the bottom of the cockpit.
+- It must be fully mounted, controlled, responsive, and integrated into the layout.
+- It must be disabled for now and clearly explain why, e.g. `Follow-up messaging is not connected yet.`
+- There is currently no frontend/backend send-message interface. Do not add one in this task and do not pretend messages were delivered.
+- Use a future-ready discriminated state rather than a hard-coded disabled prop. Suggested shape:
+
+```ts
+type ComposerState =
+  | { status: "disabled"; reason: string }
+  | { status: "ready" }
+  | { status: "submitting" }
+  | { status: "streaming" }
+  | { status: "error"; message: string }
+```
+
+Keep conversation messages distinct from case events; a `CaseEvent` is not a chat message.
+
+### Collapsible live activity
+
+- Replace the flat checklist presentation with collapsible live activity sections.
+- Render only sections and steps that have started or contain actual available data.
+- Hide pending placeholders, empty details, and unavailable fields.
+- Automatically open the active section.
+- Completed sections should be collapsible, normally collapsed by default.
+- Preserve manual open/closed choices where practical.
+- Put the data mapping behind a pure module such as `buildCockpitView(snapshot, plan, events)`. UI modules should consume the resulting small interface instead of independently joining raw transport data.
+
+### Calling-agent trigger card
+
+- While an outreach step is active, show a compact calling-agent card inside the collapsible trigger.
+- Truthful available fields include supplier identity, active/completed state, plan timestamps, task identifiers, masked phone data, and eventually Claim data.
+- Do not invent a named agent, dialing/connected phase, transcript progress, or provider state that the backend did not supply.
+- A truthful fallback label is `Calling agent` plus supplier name and elapsed time when derivable.
+- Avoid nested buttons: the card content within the collapsible trigger should not itself be interactive. Put any call-detail action beside/outside the trigger.
+- Once a Claim is collected, completed transcript/evidence/details can appear if present.

+## Live data already available
+
+The backend `CaseSnapshot` in `packages/contracts/models.py` and `GET /cases/{case_id}` in `apps/api/src/supplyos_api/routers/cases.py` already return more than the frontend type declares:

+- outreach tasks and briefs

+- decision strategies and landed-cost lines
+- recommended strategy, rationale, report URLs, PR URL, and Devin session URL
+
+The frontend model at `apps/web/lib/live/types.ts` currently omits most of these fields. Expand its transport types to match the backend contract before building presentation state. Candidate fields also omit backend `confidence` and `source`.
+
+The current plan model already provides stable step IDs, section/group, status, detail, supplier reference, `started_at`, and `completed_at`.
+
+## Data that is not currently available
+
+The old deterministic UI displayed some simulated information that cannot be represented truthfully today:
+
+- Synthetic agent names and identity-specific avatars.
+- Exact queued -> dialing -> connected -> completed phases.
+- Progressively appearing call transcript turns; live data provides transcripts after the Claim is collected.
+- Devin's actual internal tool calls, request/response bodies, and token-streamed assistant messages.
+- User follow-up message delivery.
+- A persisted human `buyer recorded this decision` state; the backend currently exposes the automated recommendation.
+
+Do not fabricate these. Render partial live data and omit absent fields.

+- A pure live presentation model module, e.g. `apps/web/lib/live/cockpit-view.ts`

+Avoid modifying `apps/web/package-lock.json` unless dependencies genuinely change.

+## Verification and acceptance
+
+- The left sidebar, center conversation/activity area, right candidate inspector, and bottom composer coexist without broken scrolling or height calculations.
+- Mobile sidebar behavior works.
+- The composer is visibly disabled and cannot submit through mouse or keyboard.
+- Pending/unavailable content is absent rather than rendered as invented placeholders.

+- No deterministic `CALLS`/`SCRIPT` fixture is imported into the live cockpit path.
+- Money remains exact/string-backed in TypeScript.
+- No raw phone number is exposed.
+- Run `python run.py test` and the frontend lint/build commands documented in `README.md`.
+
+## Suggested skills
